subject: Nov 9–15 ledger tie-out: unexpected token delta
messages:
From: Ava Collins <ava.collins@lumenia.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@lumenia.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Unexpected token variance for Nov 9–15 / preliminary invoice question

Hi Grace —

We reviewed the draft invoice for the November billing period and see an unexplained ~18% uplift in billed tokens for our embed ingestion between Nov 9–15. We pulled a short sample (attached: usage_sample_20261115.csv) showing sequences where the same document ID appears twice with slightly different token counts. Our AP team is flagged and holding payment pending a reconciliation.

Could your team confirm whether any mid-cycle reprocessing or replay occurred on those dates that could cause duplicate attribution? We also need the VAT treatment to be clear if a retroactive adjustment is issued.

Requested next steps:
- Short explanation of root cause (if known) and whether this was internal (routing/replay) or client-side.
- Evidence: sampling of server request IDs and timestamps for the duplicated rows.
- ETA for a remediation or provisional credit while you investigate.

Thanks — we need to close this with AP by Wednesday to avoid our PO expiring.

Ava Collins
Head of Platform Ops, Lumenia
ava.collins@lumenia.com
Attachments: usage_sample_20261115.csv (CSV, 12 rows)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Unexpected token variance for Nov 9–15 / preliminary invoice question

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the sample and the heads-up — sorry for the disruption. I've looped in Ben (customer lead) and Rishi (infra) to get logs and an initial triage. Quick answers up front:
- We will prioritize a sample-level tie-out (request IDs + server traces) and confirm whether this is an attribution duplication in our reprocessor or an ingest duplication on your side.
- If we confirm a Redwood-side duplication, we'll propose a provisional credit against the Nov invoice and follow with a technical postmortem.

Ben / Rishi — could you triage the sample attached and pull request-level traces for the request_ids in rows 3, 7 and 9? Ava: if you can also share any client-side request IDs (X-Client-Request-Id) that would speed this up.

I'll coordinate with AP and keep Lumenia updated daily until resolved.

Best,
Grace O'Connor

To move quickly, please confirm the PO number for November and the exact amount AP is holding. Once Grace confirms the sample matches our traces we'll create a provisional credit memo (attached: provisional_credit_terms.pdf) and push to accounting.

- Ben

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Unexpected token variance for Nov 9–15 / preliminary invoice question

Hi all —

Triage update (root cause and evidence):

Summary: Nightly reprocessor job RP-56 ran an out-of-order backfill on Nov 10 that re-ingested a subset of documents without applying the per-tenant dedupe tag. That produced duplicate entries for ~1.9k document IDs across Nov 9–11; the sample Ava sent matches traces we pulled (same request_id + server_txid appearing twice with 1–3 token difference due to truncation differences).

Evidence (attached / links):
- reprocess_trace.log (traces for request_ids: rq_8a3f, rq_9c2b, rq_d1fa) — shows two separate ingestion events within RP-56 for same doc keys.
- query_sample.json — SQL used to extract duplicates and the output used to generate the CSV.
- Drive folder: https://drive.redwoodinternal.com/drive/folders/lumenia-incident-8941 (redacted redwood traces)

Actions taken:
1) We paused RP-56 pending a code fix (dedupe tag regression introduced in a recent patch).
2) We're preparing a cleanup job to mark the duplicate rows as reprocess-duplicates and exclude them from billing; this will be staged in our sandbox and then run in prod after a quick QA.
3) We'll produce a reconciled sample CSV and ledger tie-out report by EOD Nov 19.

VAT/tax note: Because this is a Redwood-side attribution error (not a customer-side re-ingest), any retroactive credit will be issued with a matching VAT adjustment note and an updated invoice that indicates the credit reason code. We'll coordinate the VAT line items with your AP team to ensure correct reverse-charge handling.

Next steps / asks:
- Ava: confirm AP PO number and the held amount so we can draft a provisional credit memo that matches your internal workflow.
- Grace / Ben: please authorize provisional credit up to the duplicate-token dollar value; accounting will hold off final posting until the reconciliation is complete.

Quote from earlier mail for context: "We pulled a short sample (attached) showing sequences where the same document ID appears twice with slightly different token counts." — those rows are present in the trace.

I'll follow up once the tie-out report is ready.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Lead, Inference Reliability, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
